* Pinching the screen zooms the chart
* Tapping the location button shows your actual boat position on the chart. 
* Select Local or UTC time.

Select the rate tool to auto calculate the interpolated tidal rate when in between neaps and springs.

The app automatically selects the nearest Dover HW time of the day, but if you want to see data for the next or previous HW of the day, swipe forward or back to advance the tidal hour.
